title: An improved method for measuring metaldehyde in surface water using liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry
author: Schumacher, Castle, et al.

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards
steps.instruction: Dilute the stock metaldehyde solution (50 μg/L) in ultrapure water to make working calibration standards at concentrations of 0, 10, 50, 100, 300, 500, 750 and 1000 ng/L.

steps.title: Attach HLB cartridge to valve
steps.instruction: Attach an Oasis HLB cartridge to the 12‑port/6‑position selection valve.

steps.title: Prepare sample vials with internal standard
steps.instruction: Add sample or calibration standard and internal standard to labelled silanized autosampler vials, mix, and place the vials in the autosampler tray.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of each sample or calibration standard solution to a labelled silanized autosampler vial.
Add 20 μL of internal standard solution (50 μg/L) to each vial.
Transfer the vials to the autosampler tray.

steps.title: Load LC method into software
steps.instruction: Load the method containing the full LC conditions and switching‑valve program (as shown in Table 3) into the MassHunter data acquisition software.

steps.title: Stabilize system and check for leaks
steps.instruction: Allow the system to stabilise for 30 min before starting analysis and verify that the on‑line enrichment and HPLC system are leak‑free.

substeps.instruction: Allow system to stabilise for 30 min.
Ensure the on‑line enrichment and HPLC system are leak‑free.

steps.title: Analyze samples and generate calibration
steps.instruction: Run the analysis of samples and calibration standards and create a calibration table using the MassHunter data analysis software.

substeps.instruction: Analyze the prepared samples and calibration standards.
Prepare a calibration table via the MassHunter data analysis software.
